captions.detailed: A pedestal-mounted three-branch tooling tree consisting of a heavy, black cylindrical base and a vertical grey metallic column. Three independent, black rectangular clamp blocks are mounted at different heights on the column, each supporting a blue cylindrical arm. Each arm terminates in an orange rectangular faceplate with mounting holes. The three branches are independently articulated, allowing each arm to rotate on a revolute joint relative to its respective support block.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a pedestal-mounted three-branch tooling tree. The assembly must feature a heavy cylindrical base, a vertical grey central column, and three independent branches at different heights, each consisting of a black clamping block, a blue arm, and an orange faceplate, with revolute joints allowing each arm to rotate independently.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a large Cylinder primitive, and stack a vertical grey Cylinder on top of it to form the central column. Create three independent branch sub-assemblies, each consisting of a Box for the clamping block, a Cylinder for the arm, and a thin Box for the faceplate. Position these branches at distinct heights along the column, and define revolute joints between each clamp block and its corresponding arm to enable independent rotational movement.
